job.description:
About the Opportunity
This is an outstanding opportunity for an experienced Litigation Lawyer looking to establish themselves within the highly specialised Owners Corporation sector.

You'll take ownership of a diverse range of matters from commencement through to resolution, working closely with sophisticated clients while enjoying significant autonomy and support. The practice acts on a broad range of disputes and advisory matters, including building defects, debt recovery, compliance issues, licensing, leasing, subdivisions and general property-related matters.

Offering direct client engagement, quality work and strong mentoring, this role provides an excellent platform to further develop your expertise and profile in a thriving niche area.

About You
To succeed in this role, you will bring:
  • Approximately 3+ years post admission litigation experience, including property litigation ideally in relation to Owners' Corporation matters underpinned by an knowledge of the Owners Corporations Act (ideal but not essential)
  • Experience in Construction would be an advantage
  • Strong commercial acumen and the ability to deliver practical, strategic advice
  • Excellent drafting, negotiation and communication skills
  • A proactive approach to client service and relationship building
  • The confidence to manage matters independently while working collaboratively within a team
In return for your skills, experience, drive & enthusiasm you will enjoy an attractive salary package together with an excellent career path and a real sense of belonging within this collegiate team!

About our Client
Our client is a highly regarded CBD law firm with a strong reputation for excellence and client service. Known for its collaborative culture, accessible leadership and steady flow of quality work, the firm offers a genuine long-term career opportunity for ambitious lawyers looking to grow their practice and expertise.
